nonblocking_findings: F1 [Major] spec.md:849 (decision M3): A run with kinds that excludes a kind never reads, writes, or removes a clip, a provenance item, or an audio block of that kind. The word reads contradicts M4 (spec.md:850 to 854): the merge, the sort, and the header guard need the run to parse the whole provenance file, with the items of the other kind. Fix: replace never reads, writes, or removes with never changes or removes, and name the one read that M4 needs (the parse of the provenance file). Rationale: Green must not read M3 as a ban on the parse that M4 and N2 need.

F2 [Major] spec.md:862 (decision M6): The exact bytes of the kept line are not pinned. The list line that it replaces separates the file and the text with a tab, and the call line names each tab, but the kept line names no separator between kept and the file. Red, N3, N5, AC13-7, and the Green 1 live proof all pin this line. Fix: state the exact form, for example kept, a tab, the file path. Rationale: the separator is a design choice that the Red role would have to make.

F3 [Major] plan.md:542 (Thai rule; spec L15 and M16): The Thai rule covers week files and the track files, but dashboard/__tests__/storytime-package-practice-clips.test.ts line 1533 holds 10 Thai characters in a fixture string (verified by count; no Thai printed). Phase 13 runs this file in GREEN_TEST_COMMAND and PROJECT_TESTS, and Review A reads the test files and their captures. A non-Claude Review A or acceptance role that reads a failing diff of this file sees Thai text. Fix: name this file and line in the plan Thai rule, and require a filtered or masked read for any non-Claude role that reads the file or its failure captures. Rationale: the PM rule of 2026-11-09 is absolute for non-Claude models.

F4 [Nit] plan.md:523 (Spend): The paragraph says the Green role reads the quota before the dry run and before each real run, but the real runs of this phase belong to the Clips task, not Green 1. The Clips task steps 1 and 3 pin their own quota reads, so no decision is left. Fix: write the role that runs the command (Green 1 for its dry runs, the Clips task for the real runs). Rationale: wording only.
